change: add one pre-match opponent-relative dynamic team-strength signal

feature_contract.update_rule: after each decisive match: winner receives K*(1-E), loser receives K*(0-(1-E)); no rating update for ties or no-results
feature_contract.information_boundary: ratings used for a row are the ratings immediately before that match
feature_contract.selection: no rating parameter tuning; K=20 and initial rating=1500 are frozen
feature_contract.calibration: validation-only Platt and isotonic candidates; baseline-test selection forbidden

evaluation_contract.test_policy: baseline test and future holdout are never used for fitting, calibration, parameter selection, or feature decisions
